Type: duckdb

Connection: OK

SQL:
SELECT
  CAST(ISODOW(orders.order_date) AS INT) AS "orders.dow",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
FROM orders AS orders
WHERE
  CAST(YEAR(orders.order_date) AS INT) = 2025
GROUP BY
  CAST(ISODOW(orders.order_date) AS INT)
ORDER BY
  "orders.dow" ASC
LIMIT 21
